column3: “on every side” renders “from round about”; “advanced in years” renders “come into the days.”
“called for” renders “summoned”; “heads” renders “leaders,” and “advanced in years” renders “come into the days.”
“apportioned” renders “made fall (by lot)”; NASB reorders the clauses.
“thrust them out” renders “drive them out,” and “drive them” renders “dispossess them”; “promised” renders “spoke.”
“associate with” renders “go among”; “mention” renders “bring to remembrance,” and NASB supplies “anyone … by them.”
“One of your men” renders “one man of you”; “promised” renders “spoke.”
“take diligent heed to yourselves” renders “take great heed to your souls.”
“ever go back” renders the doubled verb “surely turn back.”
“know with certainty” renders the doubled verb; “continue” renders “increase.”
“hearts” and “souls” are plural for the Hebrew singulars; “failed” renders “fallen.”
